title.fr: Patinez jusqu'à la Colline du Parlement

summary.en: Skate up the canal with the officer. You stop at the Library, at the Peace Tower and at the warming hut, and at each one the officer explains a piece of how Canada is governed and then asks you about it.
summary.fr: Patinez sur le canal avec l'agent. Vous vous arrêtez à la Bibliothèque, à la tour de la Paix et à la cabane chauffée; à chaque halte, l'agent vous explique un aspect de la façon dont le Canada est gouverné, puis vous pose des questions dessus.

text.en: No trouble. I will be here on the canal when you want to go.
text.fr: Pas de souci. Je serai ici, sur le canal, quand vous voudrez partir.

text.en: There is no rush out here. Each stop on the canal is about how Canada is governed. Your task on the screen says what to do now.
text.fr: Ici, rien ne presse. Chaque halte sur le canal porte sur la façon dont le Canada est gouverné. Votre mission à l'écran indique ce qu'il faut faire maintenant.

text.en: The federal government takes care of things like defence, money and citizenship. The provinces take care of schools, health and highways.
text.fr: Le gouvernement fédéral s'occupe de choses comme la défense, la monnaie et la citoyenneté. Les provinces s'occupent des écoles, de la santé et des routes.

source.quote: These include defence, foreign policy, interprovincial trade and communications, currency, navigation, criminal law and citizenship. The provinces are responsible for municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways.

verification.evidence: In our federal state, the federal government takes responsibility for matters of national and international concern. These include defence, foreign policy, interprovincial trade and communications, currency, navigation, criminal law and citizenship. The provinces are responsible for municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways.

text.en: You skated up the canal with me, to the Library of Parliament and on to the Peace Tower, and made your last stop at the warming hut. Three stops on the Hill, and the errand is over.
text.fr: Vous avez patiné sur le canal avec moi, jusqu'à la Bibliothèque du Parlement, puis à la tour de la Paix, et vous avez fait votre dernière halte à la cabane chauffée. Trois haltes sur la colline, et la tâche est terminée.

prompt.en: Meet the officer on the canal

text.en: Hello! Welcome to Ottawa. Ottawa is Canada's capital city.
text.fr: Bonjour! Bienvenue à Ottawa. Ottawa est la capitale du Canada.

source.quote: Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857 by Queen Victoria

verification.evidence: The National Capital Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857 … The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area’s built heritage and natural environment.

text.en: Skate up the canal with me. We stop three times, and each stop is a piece of how this country is run.
text.fr: Patinez sur le canal avec moi. On fait trois haltes, et chacune porte sur un aspect de la gouvernance du pays.

prompt.en: Skate up to the Library of Parliament
prompt.fr: Patinez jusqu'à la Bibliothèque du Parlement

text.en: Stop here a moment. This is the working end of Parliament, and the work is slower than people think.
text.fr: Arrêtez-vous un instant. C'est ici que le Parlement travaille, et le travail est plus lent qu'on ne le croit.

text.en: A bill is a proposal for a new law. Nothing becomes law until both chambers have passed it and it has been given royal assent.
text.fr: Un projet de loi est une proposition de nouvelle loi. Rien ne devient loi tant que les deux chambres ne l'ont pas adopté et qu'il n'a pas reçu la sanction royale.

source.quote: Both the House of Commons and the Senate consider and review bills (proposals for new laws). No bill can become law in Canada until it has been passed by both chambers and has received royal assent, granted by the Governor General on behalf of the Sovereign.

verification.evidence: Both the House of Commons and the Senate consider and review bills (proposals for new laws). No bill can become law in Canada until it has been passed by both chambers and has received royal assent, granted by the Governor General on behalf of the Sovereign.

prompt.en: Answer 4 questions about how a bill becomes law
prompt.fr: Répondez à 4 questions sur l'adoption d'une loi
Trouvez la tour de la Paix

text.en: Stand still and look up. What you are looking at is not one thing. It is three.
text.fr: Arrêtez-vous et levez les yeux. Ce que vous regardez n'est pas une seule chose. C'en est trois.

text.en: Parliament has three parts: the Sovereign, the Senate and the House of Commons. In a province it is the Lieutenant Governor and the elected Assembly.
text.fr: Le Parlement compte trois parties : le souverain, le Sénat et la Chambre des communes. Dans une province, ce sont le lieutenant-gouverneur et l'Assemblée élue.

source.quote: Parliament has three parts: the Sovereign (Queen or King), the Senate and the House of Commons. Provincial legislatures comprise the Lieutenant Governor and the elected Assembly.

verification.evidence: Parliament has three parts: the Sovereign (Queen or King), the Senate and the House of Commons. Provincial legislatures comprise the Lieutenant Governor and the elected Assembly.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about the parts of Parliament
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur les parties du Parlement

text.en: Get out of the wind for a minute. One last thing, about the work no single government does on its own.
text.fr: Mettez-vous à l'abri du vent une minute. Une dernière chose, sur le travail qu'aucun gouvernement ne fait tout seul.

text.en: Not every job here belongs to one government alone. Farming and immigration are looked after by the federal government and by the provinces together.
text.fr: Ici, tous les domaines ne relèvent pas d'un seul gouvernement. L'agriculture et l'immigration sont pris en charge à la fois par le gouvernement fédéral et par les provinces.

source.quote: The federal government and the provinces share jurisdiction over agriculture and immigration.

verification.evidence: In our federal state, the federal government takes responsibility for matters of national and international concern. These include defence, foreign policy, interprovincial trade and communications, currency, navigation, criminal law and citizenship. The provinces are responsible for municipal government, education, health, natural resources, property and civil rights, and highways. The federal government and the provinces share jurisdiction over agriculture and immigration.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about who looks after what
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur qui s'occupe de quoi
